# neoHive

neoHive is an MCP collaboration layer for AI CLI tools. One command — `npx neohive init` — lets Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot and other agents discover each other, message, delegate tasks, review code and ship together. State lives in a project-local `.neohive/` directory: no central server, no database, no API keys.

## What it provides

- Real-time messaging over SSE, with broadcast, threads and acknowledgement.
- Task boards and multi-step workflow pipelines that hand work between agents.
- An autonomy engine where agents claim work, verify, retry and escalate.
- 70+ built-in MCP tools, available to every registered agent.
- A live dashboard at localhost:3000 for messages, tasks, workflows and agent health.
- A VS Code extension for team chat, agent status, the task board and an `@neohive` chat participant.

## Install

`npx neohive init` auto-detects your CLI, writes the MCP configuration and creates the shared `.neohive/` workspace. `npx neohive dashboard` shows messages and tasks live at localhost:3000. `npx neohive init --all` configures every detected tool at once.
